items.item: Theorem UI's direct OpenRouter route, its test, the openai dependency and the env entry are gone
openrouter/qwen/qwen3.8-omni-flash is a committed catalog row on the branch the endpoint builds on (one row, from claude/terminal-run-mixture)
chat_model_binding resolves the Omni Flash row with OPENROUTER_API_KEY; THEOREMWEB_WELCOME_MODEL pins the welcome model, default openrouter/qwen/qwen3.8-omni-flash
POST /api/chat/v1/projects/{project_id}/welcome checks tenant:read, models:invoke and the chat CSRF token, and takes no Idempotency-Key
Theorem reads the project title, up to 8 recent threads and the newest three last asks itself; the body carries only localTime and folders
The model call uses strict json_schema through the existing apply_response_schema, non-streaming, 20 s timeout, max_tokens 1200
400 welcome_invalid, 403 CSRF or scope, 404 other tenant, 503 binding refusals, 502 welcome_failed, each covered by a test
An audience:public bearer is refused; the route is not in PUBLIC_ROUTES
Fixed-cardinality outcome counters and latency; no prompt, folder or reply text in logs
theorem-chat-v1.json and THEOREM-CHAT-WIRE-1.0.md describe the endpoint; the contract oracle passes
openapi.json has the operation and schemas; the SDK regenerates, typechecks, tests and packs as 0.4.1 with theorem().chat.projects.welcome
Theorem UI vendors SDK 0.4.1, useWelcome calls the SDK with a CSRF helper shared with mutate(), and welcome-schema.ts is deleted
In the desktop host the headline and two suggestions render from real threads, a suggestion sends its prompt, and a 503 leaves the composer alone
After the user approves, the personal store is redeployed with the row and the endpoint, and theorem.rs shows the welcome
